_readme: Art manifest for every PixelLab-generated character (Reference Bible §1.1, §1.4 CHR-F). One entry per game sprite id.
pixellab.chosen is the PixelLab character id the sheet is built from; pixellab.candidates lists every id tried
(name as it appears in PixelLab's Character Creator, route, note) so Nich's picks in the web app can be matched.
Rebuild a sheet:  python3 tools/art/pipeline/build_characters.py crono   (all ids when none are given).
anims maps game animation -> PixelLab animation display name; unlisted names fall back to the pipeline defaults.
route: pro-concept = create_character(mode=pro, concept_image_url=<catalog image>, size=128); v3-ref = v3 rotation of a sprite.

crono.status: field set done (idle, walk, run, hurt × 8 dir); battle set pending
